A '''fire node''' was a valuable luminous gem that had a [[Ruby/Legends|ruby]]-red [[Color/Legends|coloration]]. The luminescent properties of fire nodes were enhanced by exposure to intense light.<ref name="GSWU" /> Fire nodes were part of the advance payment [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] received for running weapons to [[Duroon Rebels|insurgents]] fighting against the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] on [[Duroon]].<ref name="HSE">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>
